questions.question: If \(x-\frac{1}{x}=2\sqrt2\) , then what will be the value of \(x^3-\frac{1}{x^3}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: If \(x-\frac{1}{x}=2\sqrt2\), then what will be the value of \(x^3-\frac{1}{x^3}\)?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

If x − 1/x = k, then x3 − 1/x3 = k3 + 3k

Here, k = 2√2

Required value = (2√2)3 + 3 × (2√2)

⇒ 16√2 + 6√2 = 22√2

∴ The correct answer is 22√2.

Alternate Method

Given:

x − 1/x = 2√2

Formula Used:

(a − b)3 = a3 − b3 − 3ab(a − b)

Calculations:

⇒ a3 − b3 = (a − b)3 + 3ab(a − b)

Substitute a = x and b = 1/x into the formula:

⇒ x3 − 1/x3 = (x − 1/x)3 + 3 × x × (1/x) × (x − 1/x)

⇒ x3 − 1/x3 = (x − 1/x)3 + 3(x − 1/x)

Put the given value of (x − 1/x) = 2√2:

⇒ x3 − 1/x3 = (2√2)3 + 3 × 2√2

⇒ (2√2)3 = 23 × (√2)3 = 8 × 2√2 = 16√2

⇒ x3 − 1/x3 = 16√2 + 6√2

⇒ x3 − 1/x3 = 22√2

∴ The correct answer is 22√2.

Additional Information

Sum of Cubes Identity

If x + 1/x = k, then x3 + 1/x3 = k3 − 3k.

Sum of Squares Identities

If x + 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 − 2. Conversely, if x − 1/x = k, then x2 + 1/x2 = k2 + 2.

Sign Conversion Rules

If x + 1/x = k, then x − 1/x = √(k2 − 4). Similarly, if x − 1/x = k, then x + 1/x = √(k2 + 4).

So the value of 

(a - b)2 + (b - c)2 + (c - a)2 .

questions.question: If 5x + 1/3x = 4, then what is the value of \(9{x^2} + \frac{1}{{25{x^2}}}\) ?
questions.questionHtml: If 5x + 1/3x = 4, then what is the value of \(9{x^2} + \frac{1}{{25{x^2}}}\)?
questions.solution:
5x + 1/3x = 4

Multiply by 3/5

⇒ 3x + 1/5x = 12/5

Squaring on both sides

⇒ (3x + 1/5x)2 = (12/5)2

⇒ 9x2 + 1/25x2 + 2 × 3x × (1/5x) = 144/25

⇒ 9x2 + 1/25x2 = 144/25 – 6/5

⇒ 9x2 + 1/25x2 = (144 – 30)/25 

∴ The value is 114/25

questions.question: If (a + b + c)/2 = 16 and 2ab + 2bc + 2ca = 120, then what is the value of 4a 2 + 4b 2 + 4c 2 ?
questions.questionHtml: If (a + b + c)/2 = 16 and 2ab + 2bc + 2ca = 120, then what is the value of 4a<sup>2</sup> + 4b<sup>2</sup> + 4c<sup>2</sup>?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

First, find the sum of variables (a + b + c) = 16 × 2 = 32.

Use the algebraic identity: a2 + b2 + c2 = (a + b + c)2 − 2(ab + bc + ca).

Substitute values: 322 − 120 = 1024 − 120 = 904.

Required value = 4 × (a2 + b2 + c2) = 4 × 904 = 3616.

∴ The correct answer is 3616.

Alternate Method

Given: (a + b + c) / 2 = 16 and (2ab + 2bc + 2ca) = 120

Formula Used: (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ a + b + c = 16 × 2 = 32

⇒ (32)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 120

⇒ 1024 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 120

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 = 1024 − 120

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 = 904

⇒ Required value = 4a2 + 4b2 + 4c2

⇒ 4(a2 + b2 + c2) = 4 × 904

⇒ 4(a2 + b2 + c2) = 3616

∴ The correct answer is 3616.

Additional Information

Standard Algebraic Identity

The square of a trinomial is given by (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca.

Sum of Pairwise Products

The term 2(ab + bc + ca) represents twice the sum of products of the variables taken two at a time.

Cubic Identity

Related identity: a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 − ab − bc − ca).

questions.question: If x 2 – 3x + 1 = 0, then the value of \((x^4 + \frac{1}{x^2}) \div (x^2+1)\) is:
questions.questionHtml: If x2 – 3x + 1 = 0, then the value of \((x^4 + \frac{1}{x^2}) \div (x^2+1)\) is:
questions.solution:
Given:

x2 - 3x + 1 = 0

Formula used:

x3 + 1/x3 = (x + 1/x)3 – 3(x + 1/x)

Calculation:

x2 – 3x + 1 = 0

⇒ x2 + 1 = 3x

⇒ x + 1/x = 3

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = (x + 1/x)3 – 3(x + 1/x)

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 27 – 9

⇒ x3 + 1/x3 = 18

Required value = (x4 + 1/x2) ÷ (x2 + 1)

⇒ x(x3 + 1/x3) ÷ x(x + 1/x)

⇒ (x3 + 1/x3) ÷ (x + 1/x)

⇒ 18 ÷ 3 = 6

∴ The correct answer is 6

questions.question: If p 3 + 3p 2 + 3p = 26, then the value of p 2 + 2p is:
questions.questionHtml: If p3 + 3p2 + 3p = 26, then the value of p2 + 2p is:
questions.solution:
Given:

p3 + 3p2 + 3p = 26  

Formula used:

( a + b)3 = a3 +b3 + 3ab ( a + b)  

Calculation:
p3 + 3p2 + 3p = 26  

Now add 1 to both the sides 

p3 + 3p2 + 3p + 1 = 26 + 1

This equation can be written as 

⇒ p3 + 13 + 3p × 1 × (p + 1) = 27 

⇒(p + 1)3  = 33

⇒ ( p +1)  = 3 

⇒ p  = 2

Now , p2 + 2p =  ( 22 + 2 × 2 ) = 8

∴ The value is 8.

questions.question: Simplify the given expression. \(\frac{[1.5 \times 1.5 \times 1.5+2.7 \times 2.7 \times 2.7+4.8 \times 4.8 \times 4.8-3 \times 1.5 \times 2.7 \times 4.8]}{[1.5 \times 1.5+2.7 \times 2.7+4.8 \times 4.8-1.5 \times 2.7-2.7 \times 4.8-4.8 \times 1.5]}\)
questions.questionHtml: Simplify the given expression. \(\frac{[1.5 \times 1.5 \times 1.5+2.7 \times 2.7 \times 2.7+4.8 \times 4.8 \times 4.8-3 \times 1.5 \times 2.7 \times 4.8]}{[1.5 \times 1.5+2.7 \times 2.7+4.8 \times 4.8-1.5 \times 2.7-2.7 \times 4.8-4.8 \times 1.5]}\)
questions.solution:
Given:

Simplify the expression:

\(\frac{[1.5 \times 1.5 \times 1.5+2.7 \times 2.7 \times 2.7+4.8 \times 4.8 \times 4.8-3 \times 1.5 \times 2.7 \times 4.8]}{[1.5 \times 1.5+2.7 \times 2.7+4.8 \times 4.8-1.5 \times 2.7-2.7 \times 4.8-4.8 \times 1.5]}\)

Formula used:

The expression follows the identity for a determinant involving three variables:

(a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc) / (a2 + b2 + c2 - ab - bc - ca) = a + b + c

Calculation:

Let a = 1.5, b = 2.7, and c = 4.8.

Using the formula:

Numerator = 1.53 + 2.73 + 4.83 - 3(1.5)(2.7)(4.8)

Denominator = 1.52 + 2.72 + 4.82 - (1.5 × 2.7) - (2.7 × 4.8) - (4.8 × 1.5)

Applying the identity, we get:

a + b + c = 1.5 + 2.7 + 4.8 = 9

∴ The simplified value of the expression is 9.

questions.question: If \(\frac{{{\rm{8r}}}}{{{{\rm{r}}^{\rm{2}}}\,{\rm{ - }}\,\,{\rm{8r}}\,{\rm{ + }}\,{\rm{1}}}}\, = \,\frac{1}{{14}}\) , then the value of \(\left( {{\rm{r}}\,{\rm{ + }}\,\frac{1}{{\rm{r}}}} \right)\) is ______.
questions.questionHtml: If \(\frac{{{\rm{8r}}}}{{{{\rm{r}}^{\rm{2}}}\,{\rm{ - }}\,\,{\rm{8r}}\,{\rm{ + }}\,{\rm{1}}}}\, = \,\frac{1}{{14}}\), then the value of \(\left( {{\rm{r}}\,{\rm{ + }}\,\frac{1}{{\rm{r}}}} \right)\) is ______.
questions.solution:
Given:-

⇒ \(\frac{{{\rm{8r}}}}{{{{\rm{r}}^{\rm{2}}}\,{\rm{ - }}\,\,{\rm{8r}}\,{\rm{ + }}\,{\rm{1}}}}\, = \,\frac{1}{{14}}\)

Calculation:

It is given that 

⇒ \(\frac{{{\rm{8r}}}}{{{{\rm{r}}^{\rm{2}}}\,{\rm{ - }}\,\,{\rm{8r}}\,{\rm{ + }}\,{\rm{1}}}}\, = \,\frac{1}{{14}}\)

Dividing both the numerator and denominator by 'r'

⇒ \(\frac{\frac{8r}{r}}{\frac{r^2-8r+1}{r}}=\frac{1}{14}\)

⇒ \(\frac{8}{r-8+\frac{1}{r}}=\frac{1}{14}\)

On solving,

⇒ \(r-8+\frac{1}{r}\) = 14×8

⇒ \(\left(r+\frac{1}{r}\right)\) = 112+8 = 120

∴ The value of \(\left(r+\frac{1}{r}\right) \) is 120.

questions.question: If x 4 + x 2 y 2 + y 4 = 133 and x 2 - xy + y 2 =7, then what is the value of xy?
questions.questionHtml: If x<sup>4</sup> + x<sup>2</sup>y<sup>2 </sup>+ y<sup>4</sup> = 133 and x<sup>2</sup> - xy + y<sup>2</sup> =7, then what is the value of xy?
questions.solution:
Given:

x4 + x2y2 + y4 = 133

x2 - xy + y2 =7

Concept used:

(x2 - xy + y2) (x2 + xy + y2) = x4 + x2y2 + y4

Calculation:

x2 - xy + y2 = 7     ---(1)

As we know,

(x2 - xy + y2) (x2 + xy + y2) = x4 + x2y2 + y4

7 × (x2 + xy + y2) = 133

x2 + xy + y2 = 19     ---(2)

Subtract equation (1) from equation(2)

2xy = 12

xy = 12/2 = 6

∴ The Required answer is 6.

Given:

 \(\frac{{{{\left( {{\rm{r - s}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}{\rm{ + }}{{\left( {{\rm{s - t}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}{\rm{ + }}{{\left( {{\rm{t - r}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}}}{{{\rm{6}}\left( {{\rm{r - s}}} \right)\left( {{\rm{s - t}}} \right)\left( {{\rm{t - r}}} \right)}}\)

Concept used:

If a + b + c = 0, then a³ + b³ + c³ - 3abc = 0.

Calculations:

According to question,

⇒ (r - s) + (s - t) + (t - r) = 0

So, \(\frac{{{{\left( {{\rm{r - s}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}{\rm{ + }}{{\left( {{\rm{s - t}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}{\rm{ + }}{{\left( {{\rm{t - r}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}}}{{{\rm{6}}\left( {{\rm{r - s}}} \right)\left( {{\rm{s - t}}} \right)\left( {{\rm{t - r}}} \right)}}\)

∴ The value of \(\frac{{{{\left( {{\rm{r - s}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}{\rm{ + }}{{\left( {{\rm{s - t}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}{\rm{ + }}{{\left( {{\rm{t - r}}} \right)}^{\rm{3}}}}}{{{\rm{6}}\left( {{\rm{r - s}}} \right)\left( {{\rm{s - t}}} \right)\left( {{\rm{t - r}}} \right)}}\)is \(\frac{1}{2}\).

questions.question: If 8a 3 + b 3 = 16 and 2a + b = 4, then find the value of 16a 4 + b 4 ,
questions.questionHtml: If 8a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> = 16 and 2a + b = 4, then find the value of 16a<sup>4</sup> + b<sup>4</sup>,
questions.solution:
Alternate Methoda = 1, b = 2. These values satisfy equations given in the question.

Now,

16a4 + b4

⇒ 16 × 1 + 24

⇒ 16  + 16 = 32

∴ The required value is 32.

Traditional method:

Given:

8a3 + b3 = 16 and 2a+ b = 4

Formula:

a3 + b3 = (a + b)(a2 - ab + b2)

(a + b)2 = (a2 + 2ab + b2)

Calculation:

⇒ (8a3 + b3) = (2a + b)(4a2 - 2ab + b2)

⇒ 16 = 4 × (4a2 - 2ab + b2)

⇒ 4a2 - 2ab + b2 = 4

⇒ (2a + b)2 = 4a2 + 4ab + b2

⇒ 16 = 4a2 + 4ab + b2

Solving,

⇒ 6ab = 12

⇒ ab = 2

Then,

⇒ 4a2 + b2 = 8

Then,

⇒ ? = 16a4 + b4

⇒ ? = (4a2 + b2)2 - 8a2b2

⇒ ? = 82 - 8 × (2)2

⇒ ? = 32

∴ 16a4 + b4 = 32

questions.question: If a + b + c = 6, a 2 + b 2 + c 2 = 32, and a 3 + b 3 + c 3 = 189, then the value of 4abc is:
questions.questionHtml: If a + b + c = 6, a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> = 32, and a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> = 189, then the value of 4abc is:
questions.solution:
Given:

a + b + c = 6

a2 + b2 + c2 = 32

a3 + b3 + c3 = 189

Formula used:

a2 + b2 + c2 = (a + b + c)2 - 2(ab + bc + ca)

a3 + b3 + c3 - 3abc = (a + b + c) (a2 + b2 + c2 - (ab + bc + ca))

Calculation:

a2 + b2 + c2 = 32

⇒ (a + b + c)2 - 2(ab + bc + ca) = 32

⇒ 62 - 2(ab + bc + ca) = 32

⇒ -2(ab + bc + ca) = 32 - 36

⇒ -2(ab + bc + ca) = -4

⇒ -(ab + bc + ca) = -4/2

⇒ (ab + bc + ca) = 2      ....(1)

a3 + b3 + c3 = 189

⇒ (a + b + c) (a2 + b2 + c2 - (ab + bc + ca)) + 3abc = 189

⇒ 6 × (32 - 2) + 3abc = 189 (From 1)

⇒ 6 × 30 + 3abc = 189

⇒ 3abc = 189 - 180

⇒ 4abc = (9 × 4)/3

⇒ 4abc = 12

∴ The value of 4abc is 12.

questions.question: If 2a + b = 10, 2ab = 9, and 2a > b, then find the value of 2a – b.
questions.questionHtml: If 2a + b = 10, 2ab = 9, and 2a > b, then find the value of 2a – b.
questions.solution:
Given:

2a + b = 10,

2ab = 9, and 2a > b

Concept used:

(a + b)2 = (a - b)2 + 4ab

Calculations:

According to the question,

⇒ (2a + b) = 10

Taking both side square we get,

⇒ (2a + b)2 = 102

⇒ (2a - b)2 + 8ab = 100   [ get by the above concept ]

⇒ (2a - b)2 + 4 × 2ab = 100 

⇒ (2a - b)2  + (4 × 9) = 100    [ put the value of 2ab ]

⇒ (2a - b)2 = 100 - 36

⇒ (2a - b)2 = 64

⇒ 2a - b = √64 = 8 

∴ The value of 2a – b is 8

(a + b + c)2 = (17)2 ⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2 × (ab + bc + ca) = 289 ⇒  2 × (ab + bc + ca) = 289 - 115 ⇒ 2 × (ab + bc + ca) = 174

(a + b)2 + (b + c)2 + (c + a)2 ⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab + b2 + c2 + 2bc + c2 + a2 + 2ca ⇒ 2 × (a2 + b2 + c2) + 2 × (ab + bc + ca) ⇒ 2 × 115 + 174 = 404

questions.question: The difference between a number and the square root of the number is 2. The number is:
questions.questionHtml: The difference between a number and the square root of the number is 2. The number is:
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

Difference between number and square root of  the number = 2.

CALCULATION :

Let the number be x 

then , According to the question 

⇒ x - √x = 2 -------------(1)

On rearranging the equation we get 

⇒ (x - 2) = √x

on squaring  we get

⇒ (x - 2)2 = (√x)2

On apply the formula (a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab, we get

⇒ x2 + 4 - 2x (-2) = x   

⇒ x2 - 5x + 4 = 0

⇒ x(x - 4) - (x - 4) = 0

⇒ (x - 1)(x - 4) = 0

⇒  x = 1 or x = 4

Now on putting the value of x in equation 1, we get 

For x = 1,  

⇒  x - √x = 2

⇒  1 - √1 = 2

⇒  1 - 1 = 2

⇒  0 ≠ 2

For x = 4,

⇒  x - √x = 2

⇒  4 - √4 = 2

⇒  4 - 2 = 2

⇒  2 = 2

So the required number is 4.

Hence the correct answer is option 4)

questions.question: If x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26 and x 3 + y 3 + z 3 = 151, then what will be the value of xyz?
questions.questionHtml: If x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26 and x<sup>3</sup> + y<sup>3</sup> + z<sup>3</sup> = 151, then what will be the value of xyz?
questions.solution:
Given:

x + y + z = 1, xy + yz + zx = – 26, and x3 + y3 + z3 = 151

Formula used:

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)(x2 + y2 + z2 – xy – yz – zx)

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)2 – 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

Calculation:

x3 + y3 + z3 – 3xyz = (x + y + z)[(x + y + z)2 – 3 (xy + yz + zx)]

⇒ 151 – 3xyz = 1 [12 – 3 × ( – 26)]

⇒ 151 – 3xyz = 1 + 78 = 79

⇒ 3xyz = 151 – 79 = 72

⇒ xyz = 72/3 = 24

∴ The value of xyz is 24.

questions.question: If \(x + \dfrac{1}{x} = 7,\) then \(x^3 + \dfrac{1}{x^3}\) is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If \(x + \dfrac{1}{x} = 7,\) then \(x^3 + \dfrac{1}{x^3}\) is equal to:
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

If x + 1/x = n then x3 + 1/x3 = n3 - 3n

x3 + 1/x3 = n3 - 3n

⇒ 73 - 7 × 3 

⇒ 322

∴ The required value is 322.

Alternate Method

Given:

x + 1/x = 7

Formula:

(a3 + b3) = (a + b)(a2 - ab + b2)

(a + b)2 = (a2 + b2 + 2ab)

Calculation:

⇒ (x + 1/x)2 = (x2 + 1/x2 + 2)

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 49 - 2 = 47

Then,

(x3 + 1/x3) = (x + 1/x)(x2 - 1 + 1/x2)

= 7 × (47 - 1)

= 322

∴ (x3 + 1/x3) = 322

questions.question: If a - b = 10 and ab = 4, then the value of a 3 - b 3 + 4(a + b) 2 is:
questions.questionHtml: If a - b = 10 and ab = 4, then the value of a<sup>3</sup>- b<sup>3</sup> + 4(a + b)<sup>2</sup> is:
questions.solution:
Given:

a - b = 10

ab = 4

Formula Used:

(a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3ab(a - b)

(a + b)2 - (a - b)2 = 4ab

Calculations:

According to the formula,

⇒ (a - b)3 = a3 - b3 - 3ab(a - b)

⇒ a3 - b3 = (a - b)3 + 3ab(a - b)

⇒ a3 - b3 = (10)3 + 3 x 4 x (10) = 1000 + 120 = 1120

similarly,

⇒ (a + b)2 - (a - b)2 = 4ab

⇒ (a + b)2 = (a - b)2 + 4ab= 100 + 4 x 4= 100 + 16 = 116

Now,

⇒ a3- b3 + 4(a + b)2 = 1120 + 4 x 116 = 1120 + 464= 1584

Hence, The value of a3- b3 + 4(a + b)2 is 1584.

questions.question: If \(\rm x^4+\frac{1}{x^4}=47\) , then what is the value of \(\rm x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}?\)
questions.questionHtml: If \(\rm x^4+\frac{1}{x^4}=47\), then what is the value of \(\rm x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}?\)
questions.solution:
Given:

\(\rm x^4+\frac{1}{x^4}=47\)

Concept used:

1. (a + b)2 - 2ab = a2 + b2

2. (a + b)3 = a3 + b3 + 3ab(a + b)

Calculation:

According to the concept,

\(\rm x^4+\frac{1}{x^4}=47\)

⇒ \(\rm (x^2+\frac{1}{x^2})^2 - 2 × x^2 × \frac{1}{x^2}=47\)

⇒ \(\rm (x^2+\frac{1}{x^2})^2 - 2 =47\)

⇒ \(\rm (x^2+\frac{1}{x^2})^2 = 47 + 2\)

⇒ \(\rm (x^2+\frac{1}{x^2})^2 = 49\)

⇒ \(\rm (x^2+\frac{1}{x^2}) = 7\)

⇒ \(\rm (x +\frac{1}{x})^2 - 2 × x × \frac{1}{x} = 7\)

⇒ \(\rm (x +\frac{1}{x})^2 - 2 = 7\)

⇒ \(\rm (x +\frac{1}{x})^2 = 7 + 2\)

⇒ \(\rm (x +\frac{1}{x})^2 = 9\)

⇒ \(\rm (x +\frac{1}{x}) = 3\)      ....(1)

⇒ \(\rm (x +\frac{1}{x})^3 = 3^3\)

⇒ \(\rm x^3 +\frac{1}{x^3} + 3x × \frac {1}{x} (x + \frac {1}{x}) = 3^3\)

⇒ \(\rm x^3 +\frac{1}{x^3} + 3 × 3 = 3^3\) (From 1)

⇒ \(\rm x^3 +\frac{1}{x^3} = 27 - 9\)

⇒ \(\rm x^3 +\frac{1}{x^3} = 18\)

∴ The value of \(\rm x^3+\frac{1}{x^3}\) is 18.

Shortcut TrickIfx4 + 1/x4 = P, then x2 + 1/x2 = √(P + 2) = Q

And x + 1/x = √(Q + 2) = S

x3 + 1/x3 = S3 - 3S 

Now, x4 + 1/x4 = 47

x2 + 1/x2 = √(47 + 2) = √49 = 7

x + 1/x = √(7 + 2) = √9 = 3

x3 + 1/x3 = 33 - 3 × 3 

⇒ 27 - 9 = 18

∴ x3 + 1/x3 is 18.

questions.question: If a + b + c = 0 and a 2 + b 2 + c 2 = 40, then what is the value of 4ab + 4bc + 4ca?
questions.questionHtml: If a + b + c = 0 and a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> = 40, then what is the value of 4ab + 4bc + 4ca?
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Use the property: 2(ab + bc + ca) = (a + b + c)2 − (a2 + b2 + c2)

Substitute the given values: 2(ab + bc + ca) = 02 − 40 = −40

The required expression is 4ab + 4bc + 4ca = 2 × [2(ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 2 × (−40) = −80

∴ The correct answer is −80.

Alternate Method

Given:

a + b + c = 0

a2 + b2 + c2 = 40

Formula Used:

The standard algebraic identity for the square of a trinomial is:

(a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

Calculations:

⇒ (0)2 = 40 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 0 = 40 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 2(ab + bc + ca) = −40

⇒ ab + bc + ca = −40 ÷ 2

⇒ ab + bc + ca = −20

Now, we need to find the value of 4ab + 4bc + 4ca:

⇒ 4ab + 4bc + 4ca = 4(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 4 × (−20) = −80

∴ The correct answer is −80.

Additional Information

Square of a Trinomial

The identity (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca) relates the sum, the sum of squares, and the sum of products taken two at a time.

Cubic Identity

If a + b + c = 0, then the identity a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 − ab − bc − ca) simplifies to a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc.

Sum of Products

The term (ab + bc + ca) is often called the cyclic sum of products and is a symmetric polynomial in variables a, b, and c.

y3 - 1/y3 ⇒ (3√13)3 + 3 × 3√13 ⇒ 27 × 13√13 + 9√13 ⇒ 351√13 + 9√13 ⇒ 360√13

questions.question: If a + b = 8 and a + a 2 b + b + ab 2 = 128 then the positive value of a 3 + b 3 is:

⇒ 8 + a2 b + ab2 = 128

questions.question: If \(x - 3 = \frac{1}{2x}\) , then what is the value of \(\left( x^4 + \frac{1}{16x^4} \right)\) ?
questions.questionHtml: If \(x - 3 = \frac{1}{2x}\), then what is the value of \(\left( x^4 + \frac{1}{16x^4} \right)\) ?
questions.solution:
Given:

x - 3 = 1/2x

x - 1/2x = 3

Formula:

(x + y)2 = x2 + y2 + 2xy

(x - y)2 = x2 + y2 - 2xy

Calculation:

x - 3 = 1/2x

⇒ (x - 1/2x)2 = 32

⇒ x2 + 1/4x2 - 1 = 9

⇒ x2 + 1/4x2 = 10

⇒ (x2 + 1/4x2)2 = 102 

⇒ x4 + 1/16x4 + 1/2 = 100

⇒ x4 + 1/16x4 = 100 - 1/2 = 199/2

∴ x4 + 1/16x4 = 199/2 = \(99 \frac{1}{2}\)

questions.question: If (a + b + c) = 12, and (a 2 + b 2 + c 2 ) = 50, find the value of (a 3 + b 3 + c 3 - 3abc)
questions.questionHtml: If (a + b + c) = 12, and (a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup>) = 50, find the value of (a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> + c<sup>3</sup> - 3abc)
questions.solution:
Shortcut Trick

Use the direct relation: Value = (a + b + c) × [1.5(a2 + b2 + c2) − 0.5(a + b + c)2]

Substitute the given values: 12 × [1.5(50) − 0.5(12)2]

Value = 12 × [75 − 72]

Value = 12 × 3 = 36

∴ The correct answer is 36.

Alternate Method

Given: (a + b + c) = 12 and (a2 + b2 + c2) = 50

Formula Used:

1) (a + b + c)2 = a2 + b2 + c2 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

2) a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = (a + b + c)(a2 + b2 + c2 − (ab + bc + ca))

Calculations:

⇒ First, find the value of (ab + bc + ca) using formula 1:

⇒ (12)2 = 50 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 144 − 50 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ 94 = 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = 47

⇒ Now, substitute all known values into formula 2:

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 12 × (50 − 47)

⇒ a3 + b3 + c3 − 3abc = 12 × 3 = 36

∴ The correct answer is 36.

Additional Information

Special Case (a + b + c = 0)

If the sum of three terms is zero, the identity simplifies to a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc.

Alternative Form of Identity

The expression can be rewritten as 0.5 × (a + b + c)[(a − b)2 + (b − c)2 + (c − a)2], which is useful when differences are given.

Sum of Cubes (Two Variables)

The formula for two variables is a3 + b3 = (a + b)(a2 − ab + b2).

questions.question: Find the value of a 2 + b 2 + c 2 - 2ab + 2ac - 2bc, if a = x + y, b = x - y and c = 2x - 1.
questions.questionHtml: Find the value of a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> - 2ab + 2ac - 2bc, if a = x + y, b = x - y and c = 2x - 1.
questions.solution:
GIVEN:

a = x + y 

b = x - y 

c = 2x - 1 

FORMULA USED:

 a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc  + 2ca  = ( a + b + c)2  

CALCULATION:

Here, we have to  find the value of a2  + b2 + c2 - 2ab - 2bc + 2ac 

Now , we can  write this equation in the following way as

a2 + b2 + c2 + 2a ( -b)  + 2( -b) c + 2ca 

Now, as we know that 

a2 + b2 + c2 + 2ab + 2bc + 2ca = ( a + b + c)2 

⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 2a ( -b) + 2( -b) c + 2 c a = [ a + ( -b) + c]2

Now, here we have 

a = x + y , b = x - y and c = 2x - 1 

⇒ [ a + ( -b) + c]2 = [ x + y - ( x - y)  + 2x - 1]2 

⇒ ( y + y + 2x - 1)2 = (2x + 2y - 1)2 

Hence, the required value of the equation is ( 2x + 2y - 1 )2 .

questions.question: If a + 2b = 10 and 2ab = 9, then |a - 2b| is equal to:
questions.questionHtml: If a + 2b = 10 and 2ab = 9, then |a - 2b| is equal to:

(a - b)2 = a2 +b2 – 2ab

Calculation:

On squaring both sides of given equation we get,

Now,

Substituting values of a2 + 4b2 and 4ab from above

We get,

⇒ (a – 2b)2 = 64

⇒ (a – 2b) = ±8

questions.questionHtml: If x + y + z = 0, then find the value of \({{x^2}\over {x^2-yz} }+{{y^2} \over {y^2-zx}}+{{z^2} \over {z^2-xy}}\).

Calculations:

According to the question, x + y + z = 0

x = - (y + z)

z = - (x + y)

Now,

 \({{x^2}\over {x^2-yz} }+{{y^2} \over {y^2-zx}}+{{z^2} \over {z^2-xy}}\)

⇒  \(\frac{x²}{- x(y + z) - yz}\) + \(\frac{y²}{- y(x + z) - xz}\) + \(\frac{z²}{- z(x + y) - xy}\)

⇒ - \(\frac{x²}{xy + yz + zx}\) - \(\frac{y²}{xy + yz + zx}\) - \(\frac{z²}{xy + yz + zx}\)

⇒ \(\frac{2(xy + yz + zx)}{xy + yz + zx}\)

⇒ 2

Hence, the required value is 2.

questions.question: The value of \(\rm\frac{\left\{\left(m^2+n^2\right)(m-n)-(m-n)^3\right\}}{\left(m^2 n-m n^2\right)}\) is:
questions.questionHtml: The value of \(\rm\frac{\left\{\left(m^2+n^2\right)(m-n)-(m-n)^3\right\}}{\left(m^2 n-m n^2\right)}\) is:
questions.solution:
⇒ \(\frac{(m^2+n^2)(m-n) -(m-n)^3}{m^2n-mn^2}\) ⇒ \(\frac{(m-n)[(m^2+n^2) -(m-n)^2]}{(mn)(m-n)}\)

⇒ \(\frac{(m^2+n^2) -(m^2+n^2-2mn)}{(mn)}\) ⇒ \(\frac{m^2+n^2- m^2-n^2+2mn}{mn}\)

⇒ \(\frac{2mn}{mn}\) ⇒ 2

questions.question: If (5√5x 3 – 3√3y 3 ) ÷ (√5x – √3y) = (Ax 2 + By 2 + Cxy), then what is the value of 3A – B – √15C ?
questions.questionHtml: If (5√5x<sup>3</sup> – 3√3y<sup>3</sup>) ÷ (√5x – √3y) = (Ax<sup>2</sup> + By<sup>2</sup> + Cxy), then what is the value of 3A – B – √15C ?
questions.solution:
Identity used:

(a3 – b3) = (a – b) × (a2 + b2 + ab)

Calculation:

(5√5x3 – 3√3y3) = (√5x)3 – (√3y)3 

(√5x)3 – (√3y)3 = (√5x – √3y) × (5x2 + 3y2 + √15xy)

As, (5√5x3 – 3√3y3) ÷ (√5x – √3y) = (Ax2 + By2 + Cxy)

⇒ [(√5x – √3y) × (5x2 + 3y2 + √15xy)] ÷ (√5x – √3y) = Ax2 + By2 + Cxy

⇒ 5x2 + 3y2 + √15xy = Ax2 + By2 + Cxy

Comparing both sides we'll get

A = 5, B = 3 and C = √15

According to question we have to find 3A – B – √15C

⇒ 3A – B – √15C = 3 × 5 – 3 – √15 × √15

∴ 3A – B – √15C is –3

questions.question: If a 3 - b 3 = 3552 and (a - b) = 6, then (a + b) 2 - ab is equal to∶
questions.questionHtml: If a<sup>3</sup> - b<sup>3</sup> = 3552 and (a - b) = 6, then (a + b)<sup>2</sup> - ab is equal to∶
questions.solution:
As we know,

a3 - b3 = (a - b) (a2 + b2 + ab)

a3 - b3 = (a - b) (a2 + b2 - 2ab + ab + 2ab)

a3 - b3 = (a - b) [(a + b)2 - ab]

Given, a3 - b3 = 3552 and a - b = 6, then

3552 = 6 [(a + b)2 - ab]

[(a + b)2 - ab] = 3552/6 = 592

questions.question: Simplify \(\rm \frac{{{x^2} + 2x + {y^2}}}{{{x^3} - 5{x^2}}}\) if \(\rm X + \frac{{{y^2}}}{x} = 5\) .
questions.questionHtml: Simplify \(\rm \frac{{{x^2} + 2x + {y^2}}}{{{x^3} - 5{x^2}}}\) if \(\rm X + \frac{{{y^2}}}{x} = 5\).
questions.solution: \(\rm \frac{{{x^2} + 2x + {y^2}}}{{{x^3} - 5{x^2}}}\) ⇒ \(\frac{ \frac { {x^2} + 2x + {y^2} }{x}} { \frac {{x^2} (x - 5)}{x} }\) ⇒ \(\frac{{ {x} + 2 + \frac {y^2}{x} }} {x \times \frac {-y^2}{x}}\)  ⇒ \(\frac{{ 5 + 2}} {-y^2}\)  ⇒ \(\rm -\frac{7}{y^2}\)

questions.question: If x - y = 4 and x 3 - y 3 = 316, y > 0 then the value of x 4 - y 4 is:
questions.questionHtml: If x - y = 4 and x<sup>3</sup> - y<sup>3</sup> = 316, y > 0 then the value of x<sup>4</sup> - y<sup>4</sup> is:
questions.solution:
Given:

x – y = 4 and x3 – y3 = 316

Formula used:

x3 – y3 = (x – y) (x2 + xy + y2)

Calculation:

x3 – y3 = (x – y) (x2 + xy + y2)

Putting the value of (x – y) and (x3 – y3)

⇒ 316 = (4) × (x – y)2 + 3xy

⇒ 316 = (4) × [(4)2 + 3xy]

⇒ 316 = 4 × (16 + 3xy)

⇒ 316 = 64 + 12xy

⇒ 12xy = 252

⇒ xy = 21

Now, 

The value of x = 7 and y = 3

 x4 – y4 = (x2 – y2)(x2 + y2)

⇒ (x – y)(x + y)(x2 + y2)

⇒ (7 – 3)(7 + 3)(72 + 33) 

⇒ [4 × 10 × (49 + 9)]

⇒ (40 × 58)

⇒ 2320

∴ The required value is 2320
